title: nova-work-wire-v1
description: Canonical wire protocol v1 and verb schema for nova-work, pinning the complete command grammar, wire envelope contracts, event kinds, ordered field structures, and the 18 Rowan marks.

op.description: Typed operation name, never executable form, no Lisp, no shell, no unresolved path

request.description: Unique client-drawn request identifier for deduplication and response correlation

as.description: Author identity string recorded in :by or :generation-owner

expect.description: Expected precondition revision as decimal string, or null if unconstrained

now.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with trailing Z, or null to use session clock

max.description: Maximum listing count limit as decimal string ('0' means all), or null

deadline.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp after which caller stops waiting for response, or null

args.description: Operation-specific structured arguments mapping directly to ordered fields

request.description: Echoed client request id; null only if frame was refused before valid request id could be decoded

ok.description: True if operation succeeded (exit 0), false otherwise

exit.description: Exit code as decimal string ('0' success, '1' domain refusal/finding/stale, '2' usage error/fatal)

lines.description: Verbatim output grammar lines, split by client using second token (OK, ROW, NOTE, MORE -> stdout; FAIL, RACED -> stderr)

rev.description: Session local accepted event revision count as decimal string

pushed.description: Last clipped/shared git revision as decimal string, or '-' if no clip has occurred

rowan_marks.name: wire-length-prefix-4-byte
rowan_marks.summary: One message is a 4-byte big-endian unsigned length followed by UTF-8 JSON object.

rowan_marks.name: max-frame-bytes-bound
rowan_marks.summary: Frames exceeding --max-frame-bytes (defaulting to session --max-bytes) are refused with framed error and connection closed.

rowan_marks.name: integers-are-decimal-strings
rowan_marks.summary: Every protocol integer is a JSON decimal string (never JSON number) to protect 64-bit counts from IEEE-754 rounding.

rowan_marks.name: rfc3339-utc-trailing-z
rowan_marks.summary: All timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC with a trailing Z, never local zones, offsets, or epoch counts.

rowan_marks.name: absent-and-null-distinct-from-empty
rowan_marks.summary: Absent key and null mean not given; empty string and empty array are values; agreed with digest (:absent) vs ().

rowan_marks.name: request-envelope-schema
rowan_marks.summary: Request envelope has op, request, as, expect, now, max, deadline, args with op typed, never executable form.

rowan_marks.name: response-envelope-schema
rowan_marks.summary: Response envelope has request, ok, exit, lines, rev, pushed; lines carry output grammar answers verbatim.

rowan_marks.name: lines-carry-output-grammar-verbatim
rowan_marks.summary: Client splits response lines strictly by second token: OK, ROW, NOTE, MORE to stdout; FAIL, RACED to stderr.

rowan_marks.name: hello-protocol-negotiation
rowan_marks.summary: Client sends hello frame with protocol versions; session answers or refuses and closes, never guessing.

rowan_marks.name: sexp-store-json-wire-only
rowan_marks.summary: Restricted s-expressions remain durable work-data store; JSON is strictly wire transport.

rowan_marks.name: response-echoes-request-id
rowan_marks.summary: Every response echoes client request id for pipelined correlation; pre-decode framing refusal returns request: null and closes.

rowan_marks.name: durable-operation-id-before-print
rowan_marks.summary: Slow asynchronous work generates an operation id journaled to recovery log before printing to prevent lost handles on crash.

rowan_marks.name: operation-verbs-spelling
rowan_marks.summary: Asynchronous operations spelled operation status|list|wait|cancel with event cursor.

rowan_marks.name: undo-redo-verbs-spelling
rowan_marks.summary: Reversible mistake verbs spelled undo-plan/undo and redo-plan/redo with --request-of.

rowan_marks.name: savepoint-vs-checkpoint-spelling
rowan_marks.summary: Savepoint verbs spelled savepoint list|create|verify|restore|compare; savepoint names local snapshot vs checkpoint for clip commit.

rowan_marks.name: friend-config-model-observe-machine-spelling
rowan_marks.summary: Entity management verbs spelled friend, config, model, observe, and machine with non-node subject tokens on OK lines.

rowan_marks.name: query-specialized-asks
rowan_marks.summary: Query asks include roadmap, friends, models, ready, and fleet as specialized query dimensions.

rowan_marks.name: aggregation-and-missing-verbs-named
rowan_marks.summary: :aggregation restricted to :required-members, :all-members, :leaves; 9 missing verbs explicitly named before lock gate.
